name: Midea
summary:
Midea combines a large home-appliance business with industrial automation and robotics development. Its robotics innovation work covers core components, robotized appliances and complete embodied systems, connecting robot engineering with both household products and manufacturing operations.

Its disclosed portfolio includes MIRO for industrial settings, MIRA for commercial and domestic applications, and the MIRA X bipedal platform. Midea describes factory trials involving inspection, patrol and material feeding, alongside demonstrations of home robots interacting with appliances and preparing drinks. The company's robotics direction therefore links practical production tasks with longer-term assistance in connected living environments.
